written: 2026-11-07, after protocol amendment 5 and before B4's code (the probability-only score, the no-gaps rule, the calibration, detect, the report, score_test.py) existed, and before any detector statistic, gate or verdict was computed on a calibration or test deposit
about: Phase B, B4 (research/value-scale-plan.md; protocol research/benchmark/protocol-value-scale.md with amendments 1 to 5): the calibration of the protein detector, and the package around it. The design part runs first; the calibration runs only when B4_no_gaps passes. Not edited after the run: a difference is explained in the notes.

method_as_amended.score: a class's score is the probability of that class from B2's ridge logistic regression, fitted on B2's design rows (unchanged); class y is in the set when its probability is at least its threshold
method_as_amended.typicality: computed and reported, never in the set: the reply warns 'unlike the tables this detector was built on' when the typicality rank is 0 for every class in the set (for an empty set, for both)
method_as_amended.order: gates (negatives, counts); fewer than 20 columns: can't tell; no per-cell statistic: unlike either; per-protein normalised: can't tell; no missing value after the clean-up: can't tell; then the score
method_as_amended.calibration: every calibration subsample and its constructed log variant scored on its cleaned values, whatever a gate or rule would answer; no per-cell statistic scores 0; S3 pools with S2 into S2+S3, a deposit's score there the smaller of its subsamples'; thresholds the umbrella k-th smallest score per class and stratum (S1 n 218 k 6; S2+S3 n 68 k 1)
method_as_amended.bank_verdicts: each bank table scored by B2's model fitted without its deposit, against the calibrated thresholds of its stratum (S1 for 20 to 49 columns, S2+S3 for 50 to 2,000)

rows.B4_model: B2's design rows rebuilt from the bank and fitted give a model identical to B2's full_model (research/notebook-outputs/value_scale_b2/report.json): every number equal after the JSON round trip.
rows.B4_no_gaps: Design part. On the bank tables as B2 loads them, the no-gaps rule (no missing value after the gates' clean-up, on a table no gate decides) holds on exactly one: furtwangler_log2_imputed. Among B2's variants of the bank tables, it fires only on variants of furtwangler_log2_imputed. If this fails, the calibration does not run and the owner decides.
rows.B4_calibration_size: S1: 218 linear subsamples and 218 constructed log variants. S2+S3: 68 deposits (65 with an S2 subsample alone, 3 with S2 and S3), so n = 68 per class. k = 6 in S1 and 1 in S2+S3. Every subsample has its per-cell statistics: none scores 0 for want of them.
rows.B4_thresholds: All four thresholds (linear and log, in S1 and S2+S3) are above 0.05.
rows.B4_typicality_zero: The finding behind amendment 5 holds on the calibration split: in each stratum, at least one linear calibration deposit has a linear typicality rank of 0.
rows.B4_calibration_coverage: On the calibration split itself, each class misses at most k - 1 deposits per stratum (S1 at most 5 of 218; S2+S3 none of 68): the thresholds are the k-th smallest scores.
rows.B4_gated: Recorded, per class and stratum: the share of calibration subsamples each gate and rule would decide. Predicted: the negatives gate decides no linear subsample (no kept linear table holds a negative), and the counts gate decides no constructed log variant.
rows.B4_bank_verdicts: Linear: pbmc240_diann, kabatnik_cra_timstofultra, kabatnik_c3_region, pxd073250_diann, pxd077946_diann_genes, zamore_diann, pxd064083_t, pxd064083_b, herrera2025_fragpipe, lungmap_bpd_fragpipe, msv000099294_hmc3, msv000099294_microglia, pxd061052_spectronaut, pxd043355_pd (B2: unlike either), fulcher_tmt, furtwangler_batchcorr, furtwangler_batchcorr_norm, pxd049412_a549_singlecells, brunner_mq_singlecells, krull_singlecells, hu2023_pd_k562. Log: khoury_column_normalized, furtwangler_log2, furtwangler_log2_nan, furtwangler_log2_raw_sn. Can't tell by the no-gaps rule: furtwangler_log2_imputed. Every other bank table gets B2's verdict and reason (the gates and the size rule). Among the tables the score decides, the typicality warning fires on pxd043355_pd alone.
rows.B4_bank_variants: Of B2's labelled variants, at most 5% are given the other class alone. The foreign variants as in B2: zscore_genes log by the negatives gate, ranks linear by the counts gate, presence unlike either (no spread); percentile_ranks recorded.
rows.B4_rehearsal: score_test.py --rehearse runs end to end on the calibration split: each deposit counted once per class and stratum, the counts adding up, Clopper-Pearson intervals, and nothing written that marks the test as scored.
rows.B4_baselines: Every baseline in valuescale/baselines.py answers linear, log or no answer on every bank table, without an error. median_50 reads log on the six small-scale linear tables B2 names (pxd064083_t, pxd064083_b, msv000099294_hmc3, msv000099294_microglia, furtwangler_batchcorr, furtwangler_batchcorr_norm) and on the four real log tables without negatives. The other readings are recorded.
rows.B4_detect: valuescale.detect on PBMC240 (service/examples/pbmc240_proteins_raw.tsv, 238 cells) answers linear in S2+S3 with the calibration's id and guarantee, in under 3 s on this PC.
